gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hi: Expressive and loud, Paprika scatters its letters wide and lets its lowercase stand as tall as its capitals. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs is the modest one, with outward-pointing tips and a tall x-height that keep the text plain.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Commanding from the first word, Paprika spreads its letters out and opens its counters like a hollow reed cut lengthwise. Noto Sans Arabic carries the text with wide openings and a pronounced x-height, so enlarging it a notch costs nothing.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Expressive and a bit theatrical, Paprika sprawls its letters apart and gives every counter room to breathe. And Noto Sans Avestan, modern and clean, keeps its curve tips from touching, which lets a long passage move along smoothly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Paprika sets its commanding, widely scattered letters up top, with lowercase forms that stand nearly as tall as its capitals. Noto Sans Balinese sits underneath with short ascenders and breathing space in every curve.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Commanding and showy, Paprika is happiest when its scattered, oversized letters get to announce something. But Noto Sans Bassa Vah is the one for steady reading, with a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Paprika is all expressive swagger, with letters spaced far apart and counters opened like a cut reed. And Noto Sans Bhaiksuki is its approachable counterweight, its swollen lowercase and open apertures making the pair easy to trust.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-carian: Wide-set, scattered letters give Paprika a commanding look, with lowercase that rivals its capitals in height. Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades and works quietly below.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Paprika announces itself with commanding, widely spaced letters and counters that open like a cut reed. Noto Sans Cherokee handles the quieter work, with a tall band of lowercase, short ascenders and an e left wide at its terminal.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian reads as contemporary and tidy, with curves that stop short of closing and a large x-height under short ascenders. But shrink Paprika and its scattered, commanding letters lose their force, so it needs to stay big.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Commanding and a little wild, Paprika scatters its letters and gives its lowercase a tall, capital-sized presence. Noto Sans Devanagari answers quietly, with a compact skyline and an open-curved g that glide through a long page.
